title: Strict reduction of completed extension by zero
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $I\subset A$ a finitely generated ideal, $A/I$ additive torsion, and $P_n=A/I^n$ finite as a set (so a finite commutative ring) and perfect over $A$ for every $n\geq1$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion]. Work on the small pro-etale sites, with constant $A$-module sheaves and their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $J_j$ for the exact module extension by zero along the localized site, also applied termwise to strict inverse sequences and complexes [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact, lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Put $\mathcal T_T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{op},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline A_T))$ [def-weil-inverse-system], and use the diagram-site model [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization]. Define the strict reduction functor $\mathcal R_T(M)=\Delta M\otimes^L_{\Delta\underline A_T}(\underline{P_n}_T)_n$, computed on one flat-term K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let $C_TM=R\lim\mathcal R_T(M)$ be completion with its specified unit $\eta_M:M\to C_TM$ [lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], and put $J_j^cK=C_X(J_jK)$.

Extension by zero sends flat-term K-flat complexes to flat-term K-flat complexes. The tensor projection comparison gives a natural isomorphism of actual derived strict towers
$$\mathcal R_X(J_jK)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_j\mathcal R_U(K).$$
For every $K\in D(U,A)$, the morphism $\mathcal R_X(\eta_{J_jK})$ is invertible, and its inverse followed by this tensor comparison defines
$$q_{j,K}:\mathcal R_X(J_j^cK)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_j\mathcal R_U(K),\qquad q_{j,K}\,\mathcal R_X(\eta_{J_jK})=q^{\rm tens}_{j,K}.$$
At each $n$, its inverse is the reduction of the completion unit and its forward map is the adjoint of the $n$-th limit projection; in particular $(J_j^cK)\otimes_A^LP_n\cong J_j(K\otimes_A^LP_n)$. These statements are natural in $K$ and respect every quotient transition before taking $R\lim$. Moreover $J_j^cK$ is complete and its completion presentation gives the specified natural isomorphism $J_j^cK\cong R\lim(J_j\mathcal R_UK)$. If the reductions of $K$ have bounded-below etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], those of $J_j^cK$ have the extension-by-zero witnesses through [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. No completeness of ordinary $J_jK$, and no commutation of ordinary $J_j$ with inverse limits, is asserted.

proof.text: Identify $U_{\mathrm{proet}}=X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U$ and both constant coefficient rings by [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Choose a flat-term K-flat $P\to K$ [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. By [lem-cbc-ringed-open-flat-resolution], $J_jP\to J_jK$ is again a flat-term K-flat resolution. This proves the preservation assertion without a bound or completeness hypothesis.

Apply [lem-sf-cbc-localized-strict-tensor-descent] with $R=\underline A_X$, $V=U$, $S_n=\underline{P_n}_X$. Its normalized map is $t=q^{\rm tens}_{j,K}:\mathcal R_X(J_jK)\cong J_j\mathcal R_UK$. It supplies strict quotient compatibility, naturality in $K$, and $P_n$-linear evaluations, all on the model from Step 1.

source.place: Integral open factor; old Step 2 and scalar-linearity part of Step 5

proof.text: Use clause (i) of [lem-sf-cbc-completed-pullback-unit-tower] with $g=1_X$, $N=J_jK$: $u=\mathcal R_X(\eta_N)$ is invertible in the derived strict-tower category. Its inverse at $n$ is the adjunct $a_n$ of the limit projection. In $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},P_n)$ these adjuncts are isomorphisms by [lemma-weil-pbc-adic-completion-reduction]. No completeness of $N$ is required.

Set $q=t\circ u^{-1}$. Cancellation gives $qu=t$; its finite map is $t_n a_n$, with inverse the reduced unit under $t_n$. These formulas retain naturality and transitions. By [lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction], $C_XN$ is complete and equals $R\lim\mathcal R_XN$. Apply functorial $R\lim$ to $t$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit] to obtain the specified $J_j^cK\cong R\lim J_j\mathcal R_UK$.

source.place: Integral open factor; old Steps 4, 6 and 7

proof.text: For a retained witness $(L_n,\alpha_n)$, apply the sheaf comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] degreewise. Since $P_n$ is a finite ring, $J_j$ on $\underline{P_n}$-modules is the functor $j_!^{\rm proet}$ of [def-weil-extension-by-zero] used by the comparison node: both sheafify the same extension-by-zero presheaf on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U$ (Step 1), and the $P_n$-linear $j_{S_n!}$ of Step 2 forgets to $J_j$. The comparison inverse image is exact: it is a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint on module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]; both extensions are exact [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact, lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero]. Thus it gives $\delta_n:\nu_X^*j_!^{et}L_n\cong J_j\nu_U^*L_n$ on bounded-below complexes. The pair $(j_!^{et}L_n,q_n^{-1}J_j(\alpha_n)\delta_n)$ is the required witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Its maps are $P_n$-linear by Steps 2–3. Each $n$ is independent; no witness transitions or commutation of $J_j$ with limits is used.
